changelog:
v4.2.13 — Shows that froze mid-episode now keep playing

• Fixed the freeze where a show would stop with the picture stuck but no error — most often after resuming, and most often on Dolby shows. The app now decodes Dolby audio itself instead of passing it straight to your TV or soundbar, which is what was locking up. This also clears up the misleading "video format not supported" message that appeared afterward.

• Season and episode numbers now appear in the title on every screen — "The Closer – S1 E3 – The Big Picture" — including the player, Continue Watching, and Watch It Again.

• New Ooustream logo across the app, matching our website.

Note for surround-sound setups: audio is now sent as high-quality stereo rather than Dolby bitstream to your receiver. Tell us if you'd like a setting to choose.
